# nv-main — core NanoClaw infrastructure.
# Owns everything that is NOT a project-specific overlay.
#
# This allowlist is intentionally broad — nv-main is where infrastructure,
# agent-runner code, setup wizards, tests, and shared skills live.

# Top-level config / docs / tooling:
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
# The install policy that governs pnpm-lock.yaml — same owner as the lockfile it
# constrains. Missing until the F01 fix needed to edit them, which is itself the
# argument for listing them: the supply-chain settings (minimumReleaseAge,
# onlyBuiltDependencies, minReleaseAge) belong exactly where package.json and
# pnpm-lock.yaml already live, and nowhere else can be canonical for them.
pnpm-workspace.yaml
.npmrc
tsconfig.json
# The typecheck-only view of the same tree. Separate from tsconfig.json because
# that one is the BUILD config (rootDir ./src, outDir dist, declaration) and
# cannot reach setup/ or scripts/ without breaking the build. Same owner as the
# tsconfig it extends — nowhere else can be canonical for it.
tsconfig.typecheck.json
# The Python equivalent of tsconfig.typecheck.json: config for the ruff gate in
# ci.yml, which lints the path-guard matcher, the KB observability producers and
# the skill scripts. Same owner as the workflow that runs it — .github/** is
# already nv-main's, and a lint config that could diverge from the job invoking
# it is worse than no config.
ruff.toml
vitest.config.ts
vitest.setup.ts
.github/**
docs/**
CLAUDE.md
README.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
LICENSE
.gitignore
.env.example
.prettierrc*
.eslintrc*
# ESLint's flat config. `.eslintrc*` above only matches the LEGACY filename;
# eslint renamed the entry point to eslint.config.js and upstream's config
# arrived under the new name, so the stale pattern matched nothing and the file
# read as unowned. Same owner as the lint config it replaces — and it is
# ratcheted by ci.yml, which .github/** already puts here.
eslint.config.js
.husky/**
groups/main/CLAUDE.md

# ops/ — the prod observability stack, added 2026-08-11 (#1187).
#
# The metrics collector and the Grafana dashboard JSON previously existed ONLY
# on the prod box, at /usr/local/bin/ and /var/lib/grafana/dashboards/. Nothing
# in git described them, which is how a collector defect that silently stopped
# recording issuePartition.winRate went unnoticed from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-11
# while the dashboard kept rendering the stale final value as current.
#
# This is infra that configures the box, which is the same class as .github/**
# and setup/** — nv-main owns it. It is deliberately NOT owned by nv-dashboard:
# that branch owns the in-repo NanoClaw dashboard (dashboard/**, port 3737),
# a different artifact from the Grafana board on 13000.
ops/**

# OneCLI gateway skill — the container-side credential model (#1337). Restored
# from upstream after 1240a0cf deleted the in-repo copy in favour of a runtime
# fetch this fork never absorbed, leaving CLAUDE.md citing a path that did not
# exist. Shared infrastructure, not project-specific: every coworker reaches
# external APIs through this proxy.
container/skills/onecli-gateway/**

# Upstream sync (0d9328d2, 2026-09-03): upstream moved the Slack agents
# companion skills in-tree and made `main` canonical for them (bcc53e88), so
# they now arrive on every sync. Same class as the absorbed upstream skills
# above (claw, learn, migrate-memory, the Qodo pair) and as the
# `.claude/skills/add-*/**` and `slack-formatting` entries already here:
# channel-side, not project-overlay. Verified neither path existed on
# origin/nv-main before this merge, so this RECORDS new upstream ownership
# rather than widening the fork's.
.claude/skills/slack-a2a-rooms/**
.claude/skills/slack-agent-flow/**
